modules.name: Datum and CRS registry
modules.design_question: Which horizontal frame and vertical datum let City LiDAR, HRDEM/MRDEM, LidarBC, SRTM, footprints and cone heights agree to centimetres, with realisation, epoch and geoid recorded for every layer?
modules.method: Canonical frame: EPSG:3157 and CGVD28GVRD as realised in City LiDAR (HTMVBC00, epoch 1997). Tag every layer with realisation, epoch, datum, geoid and edition. Primary chain for CGVD2013 layers (HRDEM, MRDEM, LidarBC): H28 = H2013 + N_CGG2013a - N_HTMVBC00 through ellipsoidal height. N_CGG2013a comes from ca_nrc_CGG2013an83; N_HTMVBC00 from the 37.5 KB GeoBC BYN read by GDAL (gdal_translate -unscale -ot Float32; mask 9999; CRS from header). Cross-check with national HT2 grids for the layer epoch (EPSG:10617 to 10619 inverted; source is CGVD28(HTv2.0), not GVRD). Map HTMVBC00 minus ca_nrc_HT2_1997, and CGG2013an83 minus CGG2013n83, over the AOI; report maxima. sigma_datum comes from measured residuals, never the EPSG 0.0. Bridge: City DEM 2013 versus HRDEM VILLE_VANCOUVER 2013 on hard flat ground, plus a negative test on the unconverted layer; fix the vgridshift sign in a unit test at CHS 07735. Convert EGM96 and EGM2008 through PROJ grids. Use NTv2 EPSG:9119 for layers labelled EPSG:26910; assert not ballpark. Measure City 2022 versus NRCan COPC 2016 offsets on 10+ roof corners. Set water level from CHS 07735. Cone tests compare geodetic H directly (M04). Confirm cone datum and curvature convention with views@vancouver.ca.
inputs: HTMVBC00 BYN (GeoBC) and PROJ-data grids: CGG2013an83, CGG2013n83, HT2_1997, HT2_2002v70, HT2_2010v70 (and _CGG2013a), BC_93_05, EGM96, EGM2008
CHS station 07735 datum offsets and tidal heights
Public Views Guidelines s.2 'maximum geodetic height'
City answer on cone datum and curvature (pending)
outputs: datum registry JSON per layer (CRS, realisation, epoch, geoid, edition)
offset table City DTM vs HRDEM, MRDEM and LidarBC; HTMVBC00-minus-HT2 map
transform unit tests incl. vgridshift sign, negative test and not-ballpark assertion
one-paragraph datum statement for the app

parameters.name: Z_CGVD2013a vs Z_CGVD28
parameters.relationship: From H = h - N: Z_2013 - Z_28 = N_hybrid - N_CGG2013a. CHS offsets imply about +0.12 m at Vancouver. PROJ default multiplier -1 gives Z_target = Z_source - grid; the file sign is fixed by unit test.

parameters.name: HTMVBC00 local correction
parameters.relationship: delta = N_HTMVBC00 - N_HT2_1997 from the two grids; Z_28GVRD = Z_28(HTv2.0) - delta. GeoBC calls HTMVBC00 an enhanced HTv2.0. Magnitude not yet computed; the 37.5 KB BYN download needs team approval.

parameters.name: Geoid and epoch per layer
parameters.relationship: City 2022: CGVD28GVRD with HTMVBC00. PROJ-data: HT2_1997 epoch 1997 (NAD83(CSRS)v2), HT2_2002v70 epoch 2002 (v4), HT2_2010v70 epoch 2010; CGG2013an83 is v6. Epoch mixing through ellipsoidal height is unquantified.

parameters.name: Ellipsoidal vs orthometric
parameters.relationship: h = H + N; N differs by model (CGG2013a, HTMVBC00, EGM96, EGM2008), so heights from different models must not be mixed.

parameters.name: sigma_datum
parameters.relationship: sigma_datum = sqrt(s_bridge^2 + s_epoch^2 + s_local^2), each measured. EPSG accuracy 0.0 for the 1997 variant is definitional, not an error bound; the 2002 and 2010 variants list 0.02 and 0.03 m.

parameters.name: UTM grid scale k
parameters.relationship: k = 0.999601 at the Vista anchor (E 491.2 km, computed); ground distance = grid distance / k, a 0.4 m/km shortening (12 m at 30 km).

parameters.name: Earth-curvature drop
parameters.relationship: drop = d^2/(2R) x (1 - k_ref): 1.96 m at 5.0 km, 2.04 m at 5.1 km (1.78 m with refraction 0.13), 70.6 m at 30 km. Line-of-sight rendering only, not cone tests (M04). Hand calculation, R = 6,371 km.

parameters.name: Water level in CGVD28
parameters.relationship: CHS 07735 heights: MWL 3.06, HHWLT 5.01, LLWLT 0.06 m (datum assumed chart datum). With CGVD28 offset -3.00 MWL is +0.06 m; with CGVD2013 offset -2.88 it is +0.18 m. Flatten water cells to a stated level.

parameters.name: MRDEM edition shift
parameters.relationship: v1.1 changed the datum transformation (about 40 cm average change); v1.2 fixed a 1 to 3 pixel offset where HRDEM is the source. GLO-30 was converted with CGG2013. Pin and record the edition.

parameters.name: NAD83 to NAD83(CSRS) in BC
parameters.relationship: EPSG:9119 NAD83 to NAD83(CSRS)v4 uses NTv2 BC_93_05 (accuracy 0.1, unit unstated). City orthophotos are labelled EPSG:26910; whether the pixels are truly original NAD83 is unverified (test on roof corners).

parameters.name: Horizontal realisation offset
parameters.relationship: Mean planimetric offset of 10+ flat-roof corners, City 2022 (CSRS 4.0.0.BC.1.GVRD) versus NRCan COPC 2016 (CSRS epoch 2010). Expected a few centimetres (unmeasured); flag above 0.15 m.

metrics.name: UTM tile-corner round trip
metrics.basis: City tile 490000_5459000 SW corner reproduces to 0.0003 m with an independent transverse Mercator (computed r1).

metrics.name: City DTM minus converted HRDEM DTM, hard open ground, same-source 2013 pair
metrics.good: absolute median at most 0.03 m after conversion; 95% spread reported separately (team target 0.4 m or less)
metrics.basis: r1 limit of 0.15 m could not detect a missing 0.12 m shift. Naive HRDEM versus City 2009 base elevation gave median +0.70 m, robust sigma 0.58 m: unusable for calibration.

metrics.name: Negative test: unconverted HRDEM minus City DTM
metrics.good: median sits at the grid value (about +0.12 m, HRDEM higher) within 0.03 m
metrics.bad: outside that band, or opposite sign
metrics.basis: If it fails, the products do not share points or HRDEM used another model; stop and diagnose before applying any shift.

metrics.name: Layers carrying full datum tag
metrics.basis: Vista manifests state the model's vertical datum is unknown.

metrics.name: Transform accuracy known
metrics.good: every horizontal and vertical operation reports a stated accuracy of 0.1 m or better, and no EPSG 0.0 enters sigma_datum
metrics.basis: PROJ may apply a ballpark transformation without warning (r1 critique).

metrics.name: Horizontal offset City 2022 vs COPC 2016 on roof corners
metrics.good: mean offset 0.15 m or less
metrics.basis: Team threshold; LiDAR corner picking has its own noise, so use the mean of 10 or more corners.

modules.name: Footprint authority and conflation
modules.design_question: Which polygon represents each downtown building today, including post-2015 towers, with podium and tower parts separated and parcel-split polygons not mistaken for change?
modules.method: Core subset: (1) reproject City 2015 footprints (154,124 polygons) to EPSG:3157; (8) give every feature id, fp_source, fp_year, lidar_date, change flag; hand-trace the 15 tallest towers, including post-2015 ones, from LiDAR DSM hillshade. Steps 2 to 7 and 9 are v1. (2) Build a LiDAR building mask from City 2022 building-class returns more than 2.5 m above ground, 0.5 m raster. (3) Split components where adjacent roof heights differ by more than 3 m. (4) Match by one-sided coverage, not IoU: c_poly and c_part (nearest-polygon partition); IoU only for free-standing buildings. Mask-only parts are new, polygon-only demolished, middling changed. (5) Roofs 30 m or higher take regularised LiDAR outlines (simplify 0.25 to 0.5 m, snap within 5 degrees), since 2015 orthophoto tracing can carry relief displacement. (6) Dissolve parcel-split polygons inside one mask part when roof P90 differs under 1 m. (7) OSM only as a separate optional overlay; Overture, Microsoft heights and City 2009 as cross-checks. (9) QA on DSM hillshade; test on tile 490000_5459000 first.
outputs: footprints in EPSG:3157 with provenance and change flags
list of new, demolished and changed buildings (v1)
tower repair list (15 hand-traced towers in core)

parameters.name: Coverage classes
parameters.relationship: Kept if c_poly and c_part are both at least 0.8; changed between 0.3 and 0.8; mask-only is new; polygon-only is demolished. Team starting values to tune on tile 490000_5459000 (v1).

parameters.name: Mask height threshold
parameters.relationship: Building mask = building-class returns with z minus ground above 2.5 m (team choice).

parameters.name: Roof-height break
parameters.relationship: Split mask components where adjacent roof heights differ by more than 3 m so podiums and towers separate (team choice, tune on the fixture tile).

parameters.name: Parcel-split merge
parameters.relationship: City splits contiguous buildings at parcel lines; dissolve touching polygons inside one mask part when absolute p90 roof difference is below 1 m.

parameters.name: Simplification tolerance
parameters.relationship: Douglas-Peucker 0.25 to 0.5 m bounds added horizontal error; 2018 LiDAR horizontal accuracy is 0.36 m (95%).

parameters.name: Relief displacement
parameters.relationship: lean = h x tan(theta), theta the off-nadir angle: 150 m at 3 degrees leans 7.9 m (hand calculation). City orthophoto text covers camera tilt and terrain relief, not building lean.

metrics.name: Footprint IoU versus LiDAR roof mask, free-standing towers 50 m and taller
metrics.good: 0.85 or higher
metrics.basis: Team threshold for outline agreement before extrusion.

metrics.name: Parcel-split polygons wrongly flagged changed
metrics.good: 10% or less on tile 490000_5459000
metrics.basis: Critique: IoU against block-sized mask components would flag nearly every parcel polygon; coverage ratios should not (v1 step).

metrics.name: Post-2015 towers present
metrics.good: all top-10 towers present with correct outline (hand-traced in core)
metrics.basis: Wikipedia list shows Paradox 2016, One Burrard Place 2021, The Stack 2023, The Butterfly 2024, all after the 2015 footprints.

metrics.name: Footprint edge error versus roof edge
metrics.good: 0.5 m or less
metrics.basis: 2018 LiDAR horizontal accuracy 0.36 m (95%); City 2015 footprints stated as approximate.

visualization: footprint overlay on LiDAR DSM hillshade coloured by source and change flag
coverage-ratio histograms (v1)

modules.name: LiDAR LOD1 height extraction
modules.design_question: How are robust roof and base heights derived per footprint from 49 points per square metre LiDAR, including rooftop appurtenances and towers finished after the survey?
modules.method: Per footprint, use City 2022 points inside the polygon shrunk 0.5 m, assigned through a 0.25 m polygon-id raster (array lookup). Read the numeric LAS class codes from a tile header first. Store two maxima. max_bldg: building-class first returns after spike removal (z more than 5 MAD from the 1 m cell median). max_all: every non-vegetation, non-water return inside the footprint plus 0.5 m, unfiltered, with n_above_bldg; list gaps (crane, spire, noise) for manual review. P50, P75, P90, P95, P99 come from the building-class point population (3D BAG operator); if PDAL rasters are used, label "P90 of 0.5 m cell maxima". Ground = P10 of ground-class points in a 0.5 to 2 m ring, else the DTM. Store absolute roof elevation in the canonical datum, height above ground, n_roof, n_ground, flat-roof flag. Post-2022 towers (v1): difference City 2022 against LidarBC 2025 (8 pts/m2, CGVD2013, classes 1, 2, 7, 12) and set built_after_lidar. Core: P90, max_bldg, max_all. Cone tests and the existing-tower regression use max_all (clause 3.1.1 counts appurtenances; 3.1.2 minor items listed for review); display P90.
outputs: per-building roof percentiles, max_bldg, max_all, ground, quality fields
max_all gap list for manual review

parameters.name: Roof percentile q
parameters.relationship: h_roof(q) = P_q(z_roof) minus z_ground from the building-class point population; store p50, p75, p90, p95, p99. Display p90.

parameters.name: Two maxima
parameters.relationship: max_bldg = building-class first returns after the spike filter. max_all = every non-vegetation, non-water return inside footprint + 0.5 m, unfiltered, plus n_above_bldg. Cone tests and the regression use max_all.

parameters.name: Ground reference
parameters.relationship: z_ground = P10 of ground points in a 0.5 to 2 m ring; 3D BAG uses percentiles 0 to 50 within a 0.5 m buffer.

parameters.name: Inner buffer
parameters.relationship: Shrink footprint 0.5 m before sampling roof points (team choice).

parameters.name: Minimum points
parameters.relationship: Require n_roof at least 100 and n_ground at least 20; mean density 49 points per square metre.

parameters.name: Height error budget
parameters.relationship: sigma_H = sqrt(sigma_lidar^2 + sigma_ground^2 + sigma_def^2). LiDAR 0.081 m (95%) is about 0.04 m at 1 sigma if Gaussian; sigma_ground and the published-height definition sigma_def are measured per building.

parameters.name: Block-fit RMSE benchmark (not height accuracy)
parameters.relationship: 3D BAG median RMSE between point cloud and extruded block, wall points included: 0.31 m flat roofs, 1.06 m non-flat; flat class median height about 2.5 m (sheds, garages).

parameters.name: Percentile operator
parameters.relationship: Percentile of cell maxima is not percentile of points; any benchmark applies to the point operator only.

metrics.name: Tower height error versus published (max_all, definition matched)
metrics.good: 1.0 m or less
metrics.basis: Error budget (LiDAR 0.081 m 95%, ground, roof definition), not the 3D BAG block-fit RMSE. Define the published reference (roof, architectural top, spire) per building; check City 2009 topelev and UBC bldgheight.

metrics.name: Block-to-point fit RMSE (not height accuracy)
metrics.good: at most 0.31 m flat, 1.06 m non-flat
metrics.basis: 3D BAG medians on Dutch buildings; the RMSE counts wall points as well as roof points. Compare point percentiles only.

metrics.name: Points per footprint
metrics.good: n_roof 100 or more and n_ground 20 or more
metrics.basis: City 2022 mean density about 49 points per m2.

metrics.name: Unreviewed max_all excess over max_bldg
metrics.good: every tower with max_all more than 1 m above max_bldg has a reviewed cause (crane, spire, mast, noise)
metrics.bad: any unreviewed excess above 1 m on a tower
metrics.basis: Class rules and the spike filter can hide thin rooftop elements that clause 3.1.1 counts.

modules.name: Downtown ground surface and cone-height interface
modules.design_question: What is bare-earth elevation Z_ground(x,y) in the cone datum, and how are cone limits published as absolute geodetic elevation first and above-ground estimates second, without implying a zoning height?
modules.method: Tile rule: 1 km tiles (SW-corner names) within 1.5 km of E 491221.8, N 5458890.0: 14 squares intersect but 492000_5460000 is not in the portal, so 13 (ring R0); within 2 km, 21 intersect and 20 are listed. Scripted GET to webtransfer.vancouver.ca returns 403: download in a browser (with team approval), record size and sha256, process one tile at a time in a scratch folder outside the repo, then delete the LAS. Ground-class points give a 1 m DTM and DSM; TIN-fill under buildings; flatten water cells to the M01 water level; treat bridges explicitly. Check 2018 and 2013. Convert to the canonical datum. Publish a 2 m DTM or error-bounded mesh. Primary output: each cone maximum geodetic elevation in the canonical datum, compared with building max_all at the same (E,N); no curvature terms, which belong only to line-of-sight rendering. Secondary: h_allow = H_cone minus Z_ground, labelled "above 2022 bare earth, not the bylaw base surface". Origin Z = DTM + eye height (1.68 m, unverified). Carry sigma_allow; mark every figure "estimate" until the City confirms datum and curvature convention. Regression: pre-amendment towers (max_all) sit at or below H_cone or are listed exceptions.
inputs: datum offsets and water level from C02-M01
outputs: Z_ground(x,y) and cone-elevation interface with sigma

parameters.name: Cone test frame
parameters.relationship: Compare building H and cone H at the same (E,N), both geodetic heights in the canonical datum. No curvature or tangent-plane terms in compliance tests; curvature is for line-of-sight rendering only.

parameters.name: Curvature convention unknown
parameters.relationship: A level surface at distance d sits d^2/(2R) below the tangent plane: 2.04 m at 5.1 km (QE Park to 1040 Barclay, about), 1.78 m with refraction. Whether City elevations include curvature or refraction is unknown.

parameters.name: Allowed height above ground
parameters.relationship: h_allow(x,y) = H_cone minus Z_ground(x,y), both in one vertical datum; a ground error moves the limit one-for-one.

parameters.name: Error budget
parameters.relationship: sigma_allow = sqrt(sigma_cone^2 + sigma_ground^2 + sigma_datum^2 + sigma_curv^2); LiDAR 0.081 m (95%) is about 0.04 m at 1 sigma. sigma_curv is up to about 2 m for ray-reconstructed cones until the City answers, 0 for published heights.

parameters.name: SRTM propagation
parameters.relationship: Delta h_allow = minus Delta Z_ground; SRTM actual vertical error about 10 m (16 m LE90 specification) gives a limit error of the same size.

parameters.name: Interpolation error
parameters.relationship: Linear interpolation error bound is (cell^2/8) x max second derivative; dense LiDAR keeps flat downtown error far below sensor noise.

parameters.name: Bylaw base surface vs LiDAR ground
parameters.relationship: Bylaw height is measured from a base surface built from official building grades at site corners (By-law 13067, search summary, unopened). LiDAR bare earth differs by an unquantified amount; never present h_allow as a zoning height.

parameters.name: View origin eye height
parameters.relationship: Origin Z = Z_ground + 1.68 m (average 5 ft 6 in viewer per a 2023 City memo, search summary only); unverified parameter.

metrics.name: DTM vertical error versus control
metrics.good: 0.1 m or less on open hard surface
metrics.basis: City sensor accuracy: 2022 is 0.081 m (95%), 2018 and 2013 are 0.18 m (95%).

metrics.name: Allowed-height uncertainty sigma_allow
metrics.good: 0.25 m or less
metrics.basis: Team tolerance; datum and cone height dominate LiDAR noise. While the curvature convention is unresolved, ray-reconstructed cones carry about 2 m, so this target is not met for them.

metrics.name: Existing-tower regression against reconstructed cones (max_all)
metrics.good: every pre-amendment tower at or below H_cone, or on a documented exception list
metrics.basis: Guards against datum, curvature or height errors before any compliance wording; uses max_all so thin rooftop items count.

metrics.name: Level-cone curvature unit test
metrics.good: a level surface at 5.1 km in ENU sits 2.04 m below the tangent plane within 0.01 m
metrics.bad: no test, or error above 0.05 m
metrics.basis: Hand calculation d^2/(2R), R = 6,371 km; guards against flat-plane cone reconstruction.

metrics.name: Vista SRTM baseline terrain error
metrics.good: not applicable
metrics.bad: about 10 m typical, 16 m LE90 specification
metrics.basis: USGS statement on SRTM; Vista samples SRTM at 60 m with EGM96 heights.

visualization: hillshade of 1 m DTM
difference map City DTM minus SRTM 60 m
absolute cone-elevation surface with sigma under one cone

modules.name: Multi-resolution terrain and North Shore backdrop
modules.design_question: How should terrain be tiered from 1 m downtown to 30 m mountains 10 to 50 km away, given that open 1 m LiDAR does not reach the North Shore peaks?
modules.method: Measure coverage first. Read the MRDEM-30-SOURCE asset (STAC source; 10 HRDEM mosaic, 5 blended, 1 adjusted GLO-30) over the AOI; compare NRCan HRDEM extent polygons, mosaic point queries and the LidarBC point-cloud index. 1 m LiDAR reaches the lower slopes to about 49.38 N, a valley strip east of Grouse (2016) and western strips (2019, 2024), not the Grouse or Seymour summit samples or the Lions. Rings: R0 0 to 1.5 km, City DTM 1 m. R1 1.5 to 6 km: City LiDAR to its 49.32 N limit, then LidarBC or HRDEM 1 m where a tile exists, resampled to 2 to 5 m (v1; core uses MRDEM-30). R2 6 to 25 km: 1 m LiDAR resampled to 10 m where covered, else MRDEM-30 at native 30 m (never upsample). R3 25 to 50 km: MRDEM-30. DTM for ground, DSM for skylines; canopy separate. Convert every ring via M01; calibrate offsets on overlaps. Mesh with Delatin or RTIN under error epsilon(d) = tau x d x HFOV/width; share boundary vertices or add skirts; curvature at render time. Check skylines against peak maxima found by local search. Request ridge LiDAR from LidarBC, Metro Vancouver, North and West Vancouver.
inputs: coverage masks (NRCan extents, LidarBC tile index)
HRDEM and LidarBC 1 m windows where covered (v1)
outputs: coverage map by source and ring
ring meshes or int16 height tiles

parameters.name: Screen-space error limit
parameters.relationship: epsilon_max(d) = tau x d x HFOV/W; for 60 degrees over 1920 px (0.545 mrad per pixel) 1 px is 5.5 m at 10 km, 10.9 m at 20 km, 16.4 m at 30 km.

parameters.name: Slope-amplified horizontal error
parameters.relationship: Delta z = Delta xy x tan(slope); SRTM 20 m CE90 on a 30 degree slope gives about 11.5 m vertical error.

parameters.name: SRTM native cell
parameters.relationship: 1 arc-second is about 30.9 m north-south by 20.1 m east-west at 49.3 N; Vista samples at 60 m and 300 m (coarser than native).

parameters.name: Raster cell count
parameters.relationship: N = area / cell^2; a 20 x 15 km window is 3.0 million cells (6 MB int16) at 10 m but 75 million (150 MB) at 2 m.

parameters.name: Ring boundaries
parameters.relationship: R0 0 to 1.5 km at 1 m; R1 to 6 km at 2 to 5 m; R2 to 25 km at 10 m (LiDAR) or 30 m (MRDEM); R3 to 50 km at 30 m (team starting values).

parameters.name: North Shore LiDAR coverage
parameters.relationship: LidarBC point-cloud index, box 123.40 to 122.80 W, 49.38 to 49.56 N (queried r2): 2016 (32 tiles), 2019 (72), 2024 (24, at -123.43 to -123.30 W, 49.45 to 49.54 N, 8 pts/m2), none labelled 2025. r1 union was 25%: 2016 5%, 2019 15%, remaining 5% inferred as 2024. None at Grouse, Seymour, West Lion samples.

parameters.relationship: MRDEM-30 DSM maximum in a window of about 1.2 km around Seymour is 1,436.3 m against published 1,449 m: 12.7 m low (measured r1; 30 m cells smooth peaks).

metrics.basis: Pixel angle from assumed 60 degree, 1920 px view; tune per camera.

modules.name: Compact storage and web delivery
modules.design_question: Which formats and tiling keep every layer inside GitHub Pages limits yet load quickly in the browser?
modules.method: Store buildings as quantised footprint rings plus attributes (id, base elevation, roof percentiles, max_all, flags) and triangulate in the browser with earcut. Store terrain as per-ring quantised int16 height tiles or meshes with deflate or zstd, in 1 km tile folders, with a manifest listing sha256, CRS, vertical datum, realisation, source edition and attribution, as the Vista release manifest does. Keep raw LAS, COG windows and intermediate rasters outside the repository; commit only derived files well under 50 MiB (warning) and 100 MiB (block). Serve from GitHub Pages (site at most 1 GB) with lazy per-tile loading; use release assets for optional large packs. Build reproducibly from a Python script that records tool and data versions. Benchmark against Vista on total shipped bytes per building including index files: 1,072 B central and 408 B extension (computed), not the 982 B and 320 B mesh-only figures. Measured source sizes for planning: City tile zip 1.007 GB, LidarBC 2025 tile 239 MB, 2016 tile 62.9 MB, 1 m DEM sheet 236 MB.

modules.name: Accuracy audit versus Vista and published heights
modules.design_question: How far do LiDAR-derived heights and terrain differ from Vista's OSM and SRTM context once Vista's distorted frame is corrected, and do they reproduce published checks?
modules.method: Define a regression set run in EPSG:3157. (a) About 40 downtown towers with published heights. (b) 20 or more UBC buildings with ubcv_Structures bldgheight (2021 LiDAR). (c) 200 random downtown buildings, LiDAR height versus Vista height, after re-projecting Vista geometry with the documented transform (Vista formula, then lon/lat; local ENU for the Vista own error, UTM for exchange). (d) 500 terrain points, Vista SRTM 60 m surface versus City DTM after datum calibration; also the z shifts Vista applied when re-seating buildings. (e) Cone-flip analysis: per protected view, count buildings whose cone-intersection status changes when OSM heights are replaced by LiDAR heights, using test H_cone values. (f) Existing-tower regression against reconstructed cones (M04, max_all). Report median, p95 and maximum absolute error by tier, with maps and histograms. Run the numbers in CI on fixture tile 490000_5459000. Publish an accuracy statement beside the data. Vista facts: central model 9,897 buildings (1,441 measured OSM heights, 3,656 from levels, 4,800 estimated); extension 51,510 from current OSM; local frame uses 110,574 m per degree of latitude. Moved to v1 in r2; the 5-tower smoke check sits in M03.

modules.name: Currency, provenance and licence manifest
modules.design_question: How are building currency, attribution, licence obligations and the source of every value tracked per layer so the open-source release stays compliant and free of unsourced numbers?
modules.method: Maintain layers.json with id, publisher, URL, retrieval date, upstream modified date, licence, attribution text, CRS, realisation, vertical datum, edition (for example MRDEM 1.2), acquisition date and checksum. Generate in-app credits and README attribution from it. Provenance rule: every geometry, height, elevation or override must cite a dataset id plus checksum, or a document plus page; CI rejects untraceable values, so nothing written by a language model (including GPT-6 Astra) enters layers or the override table. Flag buildings completed after the City LiDAR (7 and 9 Sept 2022) using LidarBC 2025 differencing and an override table of cited heights (The Stack 2023, The Butterfly 2024). Keep ODbL layers (OSM, Overture) in a separate database from City layers; no OSM geometry in City-derived products without a licence opinion. OGL-Vancouver is reported to be OGL-BC 2.0 with the name replaced (City text unread); default wording "Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - British Columbia." until the City string is confirmed. Re-pull view cones when the portal modified date changes (now 2026-10-19; Vista snapshot 2026-09-21). Credit Copernicus for MRDEM and GLO-30. Record NRCan grids as OGL-Canada, NGA EGM grids as Public Domain, HTMVBC00 as unstated.

validation_cases.input: Tile 490000_5459000 SW corner lon -123.13750196, lat 49.28367088 into UTM 10N (GRS80, k0 0.9996, central meridian -123).
Vista anchor 49.2827 N, -123.1207 E into UTM 10N.
validation_cases.expected: E 491221.77, N 5458889.98, so tile 491000_5458000, one of the 13 City tiles within 1.5 km (20 within 2 km); scale factor 0.999601 (r2 recomputed 0.99960095).

validation_cases.case: Vista local frame versus true-north ENU
validation_cases.input: Invert Vista's formula (x = dlon x 111320 cos(49.2827), y = dlat x 110574) for model points; convert to ECEF and local ENU at the anchor (GRS80, h 0); subtract (x,y).
Same model points projected to UTM 10N, minus the anchor UTM and the model offset.
Compare 110,574 and 72,617.1 m/deg with GRS80 meridian and parallel arcs at 49.2827 N.
validation_cases.expected: True 111,215.2 and 72,756.8 m/deg: Vista is 0.58% short north-south and 0.19% short east-west. The check_points in geo.json match Vista's own formula to 0.08 m, so they do not test it.

validation_cases.input: HRDEM mosaic WMS GetFeatureInfo, layers dsm and dtm, EPSG:4326, at (49.2858886,-123.1238138) and (49.2857295,-123.1237864); City 2009 rows bldgid 149845; published 200.9 m.
validation_cases.expected: r1 read DSM 220.72 and 227.84 m over DTM 30.75 and 30.87 m (CGVD2013), so 190 to 197 m above ground. City 2009: topelev 219.29 and 223.71 over base 30.70 and 30.76. 2022 LiDAR max_all minus ground should be about 195 to 201 m.

validation_cases.case: Towers completed after the City LiDAR
validation_cases.input: Footprints of The Stack (2023) and The Butterfly (2024); City 2022 LiDAR (7 and 9 Sep 2022) versus LidarBC 2025 tile covering the site.
validation_cases.expected: City 2022 heights lower than published 162.3 m and 178.6 m, or absent; LidarBC 2025 (files 26 Aug 2025) shows them; flag built_after_lidar.

validation_cases.input: CHS station 07735 (49.2863, -123.0997): offsets CGVD2013 -2.88, CGVD28 -3.00; MWL 3.06 m. vgridshift with HT2_1997 and HT2_2010v70 variants and the HTMVBC00 chain at the same point.
validation_cases.expected: Z_2013 - Z_28 = +0.12 m if offset = datum height minus chart-datum height (MWL then reads +0.06 m CGVD28, plausible). Grid results within 0.05 m; the unit test fixes the sign.

validation_cases.input: City DEM 2013 (CGVD28) versus HRDEM VILLE_VANCOUVER 2013 DTM (CGVD2013) at 200 hard open-ground points; then the HTMVBC00 chain at the same points.
validation_cases.expected: Unconverted median Z_HRDEM - Z_City equals the grid value (about +0.12 m) within 0.03 m; after conversion the absolute median is at most 0.03 m. Otherwise the products do not share points or transform.

validation_cases.input: WMS GetFeatureInfo layer dtm on datacube.services.geo.ca/ows/elevation at (49.3786,-123.0786) Grouse and (49.3933,-122.9444) Seymour; point-in-polygon on BC-Lower_Mainland_2016-1m-extent.geojson.
validation_cases.expected: Both return null and fall outside the extent polygon; Cypress (49.3967,-123.2036) returns 915.7 m; Vista anchor returns 31.03 m. Sample coordinates are approximate.

validation_cases.case: LidarBC tile index at the peaks and in the box
validation_cases.input: Query layer 4 of LiDAR_BC_S3_Public: points at Grouse, Seymour, West Lion (about 49.48,-123.16) and the Vista anchor; group tiles by year in the box 123.40-122.80 W, 49.38-49.56 N.
validation_cases.expected: No tile at the three summit samples; anchor returns 092g025_3_4_2 for 2016 and 2025. Box: 2016 32 tiles, 2019 72, 2024 24, none 2025 (r2). Layer 6 lists 2016 DEM sheets 092g035/036/045 there; test their pixels.

validation_cases.input: 181 tile names in the portal; tiles whose square intersects a circle around E 491221.8, N 5458890.0.
300 random City 2009 footprint rows within 1.5 km of the anchor: HRDEM mosaic DTM at geo_point minus baseelev_m.
validation_cases.expected: Median +0.70 m, p25 +0.37, p75 +1.20, robust sigma 0.58 m: grade change since 2009 and base definition swamp the datum shift, so this cannot calibrate CGVD28 to CGVD2013.

validation_cases.input: Vista unified_manifest buildings block (central 9,897 buildings).
validation_cases.expected: z shift median +0.48 m, min -12.24, max +21.61 m onto SRTM-based terrain; LiDAR ground should differ from SRTM by metres, so Vista absolute heights are unusable for cone tests.

validation_cases.case: MRDEM versus HRDEM where LiDAR exists
validation_cases.input: WMS point queries at Cypress (49.3967,-123.2036) and the Vista anchor.
validation_cases.expected: HRDEM DTM 915.67 and 31.03 m; MRDEM-30 DTM 915.20 and 30.81 m: agreement within about 0.5 m where HRDEM supplies MRDEM.

validation_cases.input: Open the 1040-1080 Barclay site-context PDF in a browser; record every 3.2.1 and 12.1.1 elevation, edition and datum text; sample the City DTM at the site.
validation_cases.expected: Search snippets (unopened): 3.2.1 from 123.201 m to about 143.4 m, 12.1.1 121.695 m. A 20 m spread conflicts with one horizontal lower boundary (s.2 p.3); record how values vary. h_allow = H_cone minus Z_ground per point.

validation_cases.case: HRDEM ground near 1045 Haro (replaces the Thurlow inference)
validation_cases.input: HRDEM mosaic WMS GetFeatureInfo layer dtm at (49.2853,-123.1275), approximate location near 1045 Haro; FORMAT parameter required.
validation_cases.expected: r2 read 40.75 m CGVD2013 (critique 40.65 m). No ground level can be inferred from the unverified 361 ft (110.03 m) Thurlow figure: its definition (geodetic or above grade) and edition are unknown.

validation_cases.input: Sample MRDEM-30 DTM and the HRDEM DTM at 200 non-vegetated downtown points versus the City DTM after datum calibration.
validation_cases.expected: Table 2 (read r2): HRDEM-derived DTM vs RTK 1.04 m RMSE, 1.69 LE90 non-vegetated, 2.55, 4.17 vegetated; GLO-30-derived vs HRDEM DTM 1.59, 2.60 and 4.99, 8.07. Downtown (HRDEM-sourced) should sit near the first row.

validation_cases.input: Run the pipeline on 20 or more UBC buildings; compare with ubcv_Structures bldgheight and baseelev.
validation_cases.expected: Median absolute height difference 1 m or less; base-elevation differences consistent with the datum offset.

validation_cases.input: MRDEM-30 DSM (WMS) in a window of about 1.2 km around Mount Seymour (49.3944,-122.9444); published 1,449 m (Wikipedia, datum unstated).
validation_cases.expected: r1 maximum 1,436.3 m at (49.3936,-122.9452), 12.7 m low; accept within 15 m. Grouse window max 1,210.4 m sat on the window edge, so enlarge it before comparing with 1,231 m.

validation_cases.input: d = 30,000 m, R = 6,371,000 m, refraction coefficient 0.13.
validation_cases.expected: d^2/(2R) = 70.6 m; with refraction 61.5 m (hand calculation, r2 recomputed 70.63 and 61.45).

validation_cases.case: Level cone at 5.1 km (curvature unit test)
validation_cases.input: QE Park viewing platform to 1040 Barclay about 5.1 km (approximate); R = 6,371 km; refraction 0.13.
validation_cases.expected: A level (constant geodetic height) surface sits 2.04 m below the ENU tangent plane (1.78 m with refraction; 1.96 m at 5.0 km). Test tolerance 0.01 m. Compliance compares H directly; no drop applied.

validation_cases.input: 1 arc-second at latitude 49.28 N.
validation_cases.expected: About 30.9 m north-south by 20.1 m east-west, so Vista's 60 m sampling is coarser than the source (computed).

validation_cases.case: Percentile and dual-maximum recovery on synthetic roof
validation_cases.input: Synthetic 30 x 30 m flat roof at 150 m, 49 points per m2, Gaussian noise 0.08 m, wall points, 20 spikes, plus a 4 m mast of 50 points classed Unclassified.
validation_cases.expected: P90, P95 and max_bldg within 0.3 m of 150 m from the point population; max_all reports about 154 m with n_above_bldg 50; also report the cell-maxima operator and its bias.

validation_cases.input: CHS 07735 metadata JSON: MWL 3.06 m (height type 5cec2eba3d0f4a04cc64d5d2), CGVD28 offset -3.00, CGVD2013 offset -2.88.
validation_cases.expected: MWL = +0.06 m CGVD28 and +0.18 m CGVD2013 if the offset is added; the reversed convention would give +6.06 m, which is not plausible.

validation_cases.input: 10 or more flat-roof corners on tile 490000_5459000 picked in City 2022 points and in NRCan COPC 2016 points.
validation_cases.expected: Mean planimetric offset a few centimetres (unmeasured); flag above 0.15 m.

sources.title: Metro Vancouver Land Cover and SEI Update (Caslys, Dec 2022)
sources.extract: LiDAR taken from member jurisdictions (mosaic of vintages 2016 to 2020), including Capilano and Seymour watersheds; internal DEM, DSM, CHM at 5 m; Buildings is a land-cover class, no heights.

flags.claim: Google Open Buildings can supply Vancouver footprints.
flags.correction: Coverage is Africa, South and South-East Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean; Canada is not listed and the page names no height field.
flags.detail: Use City LiDAR, City 2015 footprints, OSM, Overture or Microsoft instead.

flags.claim: City building-footprint datasets carry height fields.
flags.correction: Only the 2009 set has elevations and heights, as roof-facet rows under 2009 conditions; 2015 and 1999 sets are geometry only.
flags.detail: 2009 rows near Shangri-La show a tower under construction; do not treat them as current.

flags.claim: The City publishes DEM or DSM products derived from 2018 and 2022 LiDAR.
flags.correction: 2018 and 2022 are zipped LAS tiles only; the only City raster DEM is the 2013 1 m GeoTIFF (1.91 GB).
flags.detail: We must derive DTM and DSM ourselves (M04).

flags.claim: EPSG:26910 is NAD83(CSRS) UTM zone 10N.
flags.correction: 26910 is NAD83 (original); NAD83(CSRS) / UTM 10N is EPSG:3157. City LiDAR states NAD83(CSRS) 4.0.0.BC.1.GVRD.
flags.detail: EPSG remarks say sub-metre accuracy needs the CSRS code; City orthophotos are labelled EPSG:26910.

flags.claim: All elevation sources can be merged without datum work.
flags.correction: City LiDAR is CGVD28GVRD; HRDEM and MRDEM are CGVD2013; SRTM is EGM96; GLO-30 is EGM2008; OSM heights are relative.
flags.detail: CHS offsets imply about +0.12 m between CGVD2013 and CGVD28 (unverified); MRDEM v1.1 moved heights about 0.4 m.

flags.claim: Vista README: terrain is '60 m SRTM'.
flags.correction: SRTM 1 arc-second (about 30.9 x 20.1 m cells) sampled at 60 m (extension) and 300 m (backdrop), EGM96; supplied-model terrain source and datum are unrecorded.
flags.detail: Actual vertical error is about 10 m (USGS), unusable for cone height limits.

flags.claim: Vista's local equirectangular frame is adequate for cone tests.
flags.correction: It differs from UTM 10N by about 5 m at 2.5 km and up to 34 m at its extent corners (computed).
flags.detail: Fine for visuals; use geodetic H comparison or a per-view ENU frame for geometry that touches cone edges. r2: Vista's own error against true-north ENU is in the r2 flag below.

flags.claim: Cone maximum geodetic heights are in CGVD28(GVRD).
flags.detail: LTSA 465C keeps CGVD28 as legal-survey datum and the Guidelines say 'maximum geodetic height' (s.2 p.3); the datum definition was not read (403 again in r2). Ask views@vancouver.ca.

flags.claim: View 3.2.1 is 123.201 m geodetic (Barclay).
flags.detail: r2: the 361 ft Thurlow inference was removed (see FALSE_ASSUMPTION flag). Both PDFs unopened (403 again). Snippets give 3.2.1 points 123.2 to 143.4 m; 361 ft has unknown definition. 3.2.1 was amended in 2024, so edition and datum may differ.

flags.claim: City OGL-Vancouver and OSM ODbL layers can be combined in one release.
flags.detail: r1: OGL-Vancouver is reported as OGL-BC 2.0 (attribution only), but the City text is unread and a 2014 post records a negative City answer on ODbL compatibility; ODbL share-alike remains. Keep layers separate pending a legal opinion.

flags.claim: 2022 LiDAR is current for every downtown tower.
flags.correction: Acquisition was 7 and 9 Sept 2022; The Stack (2023) and The Butterfly (2024) post-date it.
flags.detail: Flag built_after_lidar and use a cited override table; LidarBC 2025 tiles can confirm.

flags.claim: NRCan Automatically Extracted Buildings has usable heights for Vancouver.
flags.detail: Feature catalogue lists Height Maximum/Minimum, but a WMS GetFeatureInfo query downtown returned empty; coverage unconfirmed.

flags.claim: LidarBC datum and licence are known.
flags.detail: r1: 2025 tiles state CGVD2013(2010); 2016 index field is blank; licence is OGL-BC in the portal record but 'Access Only' in the catalogue field. r2: the 2024 tiles in the index also list CGVD2013. Still conflicting on licence.

flags.claim: SRTM is adequate for 'as accurate as possible' North Shore mountains.
flags.correction: MRDEM-30 (HRDEM-derived 1.04 to 2.55 m RMSE vs RTK; GLO-30-derived 1.59 to 4.99 m vs HRDEM DTM, spec Table 2) is available over the same area; SRTM is about 10 m.
flags.detail: Slopes amplify horizontal error (20 m CE90 on 30 degrees gives 11.5 m vertical). HRDEM 1 m does not reach the ridges (r1).

flags.claim: City LiDAR class names map to LAS codes 1 to 8.
flags.detail: The portal lists class names as a numbered list; ASPRS codes differ (for example water is 9, noise 7). Read the LAS header or a class histogram first; r2 portal re-read confirms names only.

flags.claim: HRDEM BC-Lower_Mainland_2016-1m (bbox to 49.5125 N) gives 1 m terrain and skyline for the North Shore front ranges (M05 R2).
flags.correction: A bbox is an envelope. The extent polygon (351 vertices, 2 parts) excludes Grouse, Seymour, Crown, Cypress, Lions samples; HRDEM mosaic DTM is null at Grouse and Seymour; LidarBC has no point-cloud tile there. Ridge terrain is MRDEM-30, GLO-30-derived.
flags.detail: Measured r1: 25% of a 0.02 degree grid north of 49.38 N lies in any LidarBC tile (2016 5%, 2019 15%, 2025 0%). r2 correction: the third year is 2024 (about 5%, inferred), not 2025. Sample coordinates approximate. LidarBC lists 1 m DEM sheets over the peaks; contents untested.

flags.claim: City LiDAR 2022 heights use the HTGVRDBC00 hybrid geoid.
flags.correction: Portal metadata names the Metro Vancouver Geoid HTMVBC00 (HTMVBC00_Abbbyn.zip). GeoBC: HTMVBC00 equals HTGVRDBC00 extended east to Abbotsford; LTSA approves HTGVRDBC00 in Metro Vancouver.
flags.detail: Registry records HTMVBC00 and epoch 1997. PROJ grid epoch 2010 differs from this; use HT2_1997 variant as primary and quantify locally.

flags.claim: Vista's frame differs from UTM by about 5 m at 2.5 km; a generic projection effect, fine for visuals.
flags.correction: Cause is a wrong latitude constant (110,574 vs 111,215.2 m/deg, 0.58% short) plus 0.19% short longitude scale. Offsets reach 21 m at the north edge of the supplied model and 34 m at the SE corner; 14 m at 2.5 km north.
flags.detail: The supplied Rhino model fits the formula to 0.08 m, so it carries the distortion. Re-project Vista assets with a documented forward and inverse transform.

flags.claim: OGL-Vancouver may be 'viral' (share-alike), so City layers cannot be combined (M08).
flags.correction: The 2011 commentary predates the current licence. OGL-Vancouver is reported as OGL-BC 2.0 with the name replaced; the OGL-BC 2.0 text read is attribution-only. Share-alike comes from ODbL.
flags.detail: City's own text and attribution string still unread; keep OSM and Overture separate regardless.

flags.claim: 13 City LiDAR 2022 tiles lie within 2 km of downtown.
flags.correction: 20 tiles intersect a 2 km circle around the Vista anchor; 13 intersect a 1.5 km circle. Plain scripted requests get HTTP 403.
flags.detail: Tile list and rule are in M04 and validation cases; one tile measured 1.007 GB. r2: geometric counts are 14 and 21; 492000_5460000 is absent from the portal.

flags.claim: MRDEM Table 2 accuracy values (1.04/1.69, 2.55/4.17, GLO-30-derived 1.59 and 4.99 m).
flags.detail: Resolved r2: table read from the local PDF text. HRDEM-derived DTM vs RTK 1.04/1.69 non-vegetated, 2.55/4.17 vegetated; GLO-30-derived DTM vs HRDEM DTM (not RTK) 1.59/2.60 and 4.99/8.07. No ridge-specific accuracy; Seymour DSM peak is 12.7 m low.

flags.claim: LidarBC 1 m DEM sheets 092g035, 092g036, 092g045 contain ridge data.
flags.detail: The DEM index lists them over the Grouse, Seymour and West Lion samples, but the point-cloud index has no tile there and 17 to 24 of 64 sub-tiles are missing per sheet. Read pixels to settle.

flags.claim: City LiDAR zips cannot be fetched by script.
flags.detail: Default clients get 403; a HEAD with browser User-Agent and portal Referer returned 200 (size only, nothing downloaded). Terms for automated access unknown; plan browser downloads or ask the City.

flags.claim: City orthophotos labelled EPSG:26910 are in original NAD83.
flags.detail: They may be NAD83(CSRS) mislabelled; original NAD83 differs by up to about 1 m in BC. Test on LiDAR roof corners before applying EPSG:9119.

flags.claim: A 14 person-day core fits before 13 Nov 2026.
flags.correction: r2 core is about 7 person-days (6.0 plus 1.0 contingency): M01 1.0, M02 0.5, M03 2.0, M04 1.0, M05 0.5, M06 0.5, M08 0.5. Full packet is about 39.
flags.detail: 17 working days to 13 Nov (including today, excluding 11 Nov) for 2 students at an assumed 40% share is about 13.6 person-days for all packets; C02 core takes about half. M07, conflation and LidarBC differencing are v1.

flags.claim: If view 3.2.1 is 123.201 m geodetic (Barclay), 361 ft at Thurlow/Haro implies City DTM there is about 13 m +/- 1 m.
flags.correction: The two values come from different sites and possibly different editions, and it is unknown whether 361 ft is above grade. HRDEM DTM near 1045 Haro is about 40.7 m, not 13 m.
flags.detail: Inference deleted. r2 WMS read 40.75 m at (49.2853,-123.1275) (critique: 40.65 m). 361 ft (110.03 m) stays an unverified figure of unknown definition; compare only same-site, same-edition values.

flags.claim: The 3D BAG median RMSE (0.31 m flat, 1.06 m non-flat) is a benchmark for tower height error versus published heights.
flags.correction: It is the point-cloud-to-block geometric difference including wall points: a block-fit metric, not height accuracy. Its flat class has about 2.5 m median height (sheds, garages).
flags.detail: Dukai et al. 2019 s.3.2 and Table 1 read in r2. Height accuracy now rests on an error budget (LiDAR 0.081 m 95%, ground, roof definition) checked against City 2009 and UBC references.

flags.claim: The local difference between HTMVBC00 and national HTv2.0 is unquantifiable because HTMVBC00 is not in PROJ.
flags.correction: GeoBC publishes HTMVBC00 as a 37.5 KB BYN and GDAL reads BYN, so the difference is computable and HTMVBC00 can be used directly in the chain.
flags.detail: PROJ-data holds ca_nrc_HT2_1997 and CGG2013a grids; map HTMVBC00 minus HT2_1997 over the AOI. Not yet computed: the download awaits team approval.

flags.claim: A City-DTM-minus-converted-HRDEM median of 0.15 m or less demonstrates correct datum handling.
flags.correction: The expected CGVD2013-CGVD28 shift is about 0.12 m, so an unconverted layer also passes. Require 0.03 m or less on hard surfaces, plus a negative test on the unconverted data.
flags.detail: CHS offsets imply +0.12 m; EPSG grid accuracies are 0.02 to 0.05 m; a reversed sign would give about 0.24 m.

flags.claim: Offsets between Vista and UTM grid coordinates measure Vista's own frame distortion.
flags.correction: They include UTM grid convergence (-0.0915 deg at the anchor: 6.3 m of easting over 3.94 km due north) and scale 0.9996. Against local true-north ENU the error at (0,3940) is E 0.0, N +22.9 m.
flags.detail: r2 computed: SE corner (5674,-5083) is 31.1 m in ENU versus 34.0 m in UTM. Report ENU for Vista's error; keep UTM offsets only for data exchange.

flags.claim: Roof maximum from building-class first returns after a spike filter is the conservative maximum for cone tests.
flags.correction: Appurtenances, masts and spires may be classed Unclassified, Other or Noise, and the spike filter removes thin elements that clause 3.1.1 counts. Store max_all (unfiltered, non-vegetation, non-water) and use it.
flags.detail: Class codes unread; cranes present in Sept 2022 push the other way. List max_all gaps for manual review.

flags.claim: The City's cone elevations include or omit Earth curvature and refraction.
flags.detail: Guidelines s.2 p.3 give a horizontal lower boundary with a maximum geodetic height; nothing on curvature in the extract. A level surface sits 2.04 m below the tangent plane at 5.1 km. Compare geodetic H directly; ask views@vancouver.ca.

flags.claim: View 3.2.1 on the Barclay site has one maximum geodetic height.
flags.detail: Search snippets show 3.2.1 points from 123.2 to about 143.4 m on one site (PDF unopened, 403), which conflicts with a single horizontal lower boundary (s.2 p.3). Edition or a sloping boundary may explain it; read the PDF in a browser.

flags.claim: HTMVBC00 licence, epoch and BYN header details are known.
flags.detail: The GeoBC page states no licence, accuracy or epoch; header Factor, units and CRS are unread. NRCan HT2 grids are OGL-Canada and NGA EGM grids Public Domain per PROJ-data READMEs. Ask GeoBC before redistributing any derived grid.

unresolved_relationships: Datum behind the Guidelines' 'maximum geodetic height' values: WebFetch of guidelines.vancouver.ca, rezoning.vancouver.ca and council.vancouver.ca returned 403 again in r2; Vista data/guideline.json confirms the s.2 p.3 sentence only, with no datum or curvature text.
Whether City cone elevations include or omit Earth curvature and refraction: not stated in the extract; matters up to about 2 m at 5 km for ray-reconstructed cones. Ask views@vancouver.ca.

Barclay view 3.2.1 shows maximum geodetic elevations from 123.2 to about 143.4 m on one site in search snippets, against a single horizontal lower boundary in s.2 p.3; edition and definition unknown; the 361 ft Thurlow figure has no stated definition (PDFs unopened).

Numeric offset between City CGVD28GVRD and HRDEM/MRDEM/LidarBC CGVD2013 downtown: only CHS +0.12 m (sign convention inferred from MWL plausibility); the same-source bridge needs the 1.9 GB City DEM; the HTMVBC00 chain is computable but not yet computed.

Local difference between HTMVBC00 and HT2_1997 (and between epoch variants): computable from GeoBC's 37.5 KB BYN with GDAL and the PROJ-data HT2 grids; not computed because the download needs team approval; BYN header, units, CRS tag and epoch unread.

Effect of mixing epochs through ellipsoidal height (HTMVBC00 epoch 1997 versus CGG2013an83 NAD83(CSRS)v6): unquantified; the 1997 to 2010 national variants differ by at most 0.03 m by EPSG accuracy, local value not measured.

CGG2013 versus CGG2013a: MRDEM spec and LidarBC summary say CGG2013; EPSG and NRCan grids say CGG2013a; both grids exist in PROJ-data (CGG2013n83, CGG2013an83), so the difference is computable and not yet computed.
Difference between CVD28BC, CVD28GVRD and CVD28GVRD2018 realisations (LTSA 465B lists all as acceptable): no quantified difference found.
Horizontal accuracy, LAS version and point format of City LiDAR 2022: not in portal metadata (re-read r2) and no accuracy report linked; affects footprint tolerance and file size.
Numeric LAS classification codes in City LiDAR for ground, buildings, other and noise: portal gives names only; read a tile header or class histogram before coding max_all.
Whether HRDEM mosaic and project COGs agree with City 2022 DTM after datum conversion: STAC lacks vertical metadata; must be measured.
Contents of LidarBC 1 m DEM sheets 092g035, 092g036, 092g045 at the ridges: index lists them but point-cloud tiles are absent; not read.

Open 1 m LiDAR for Grouse, Crown, Seymour and the Lions: none found in NRCan, LidarBC (2016, 2019, 2024 tiles in the box are elsewhere) or Metro Vancouver open data; MRDEM-30-SOURCE band at the peaks not yet read; District of North Vancouver GEOweb and West Vancouver not checked in detail.
Local MRDEM-30 accuracy on North Shore ridges: Table 2 is now read (global validation, GLO-30-derived column versus HRDEM DTM, not RTK); only the Seymour peak check (12.7 m low) was measured here.
Project name, accuracy and licence of the 2024 LidarBC project (24 tiles, 8 pts/m2) west of the peaks: index fields only, reports not read.

Vancouver coverage and height completeness of NRCan Automatically Extracted Buildings and of Microsoft GlobalML (431K new height estimates 2026-07-24, largest in US, Norway, Italy; Canada not listed): not queried.
Which City of Vancouver dataset and vintage Overture merges as a building source: page names the source only.
City ArcGIS REST or VanMap building-height services: none found by search; maps.vancouver.ca returned 404.
LidarBC licence: OGL-BC in portal record versus 'Access Only' in catalogue; 2016 vertical datum blank in index; 2025 accuracy fields blank.
Real compressed sizes for LOD1 buildings and terrain meshes: estimates only until tile 490000_5459000 is processed; 20 City tiles total unmeasured (one tile 1.007 GB).
City terms for automated LiDAR downloads: default client 403, header-bearing HEAD 200; policy unknown.
OGL-Vancouver full text and exact attribution string: portal licence page returned navigation only; 'based on OGL-BC 2.0' is from a search summary.
HTMVBC00 licence: GeoBC page states none; NRCan HT2 grids OGL-Canada and NGA EGM Public Domain per PROJ-data READMEs.
Whether City orthophotos are true orthophotos and whether the EPSG:26910 label is literal (original NAD83): not stated; test on roof corners.
Bylaw base-surface definition and how it differs from LiDAR bare earth: By-law 13067 and City bulletin returned 403; only a search summary seen.
Official view-origin eye height: a 2023 City memo (403) was reported as 5 ft 6 in (1.68 m); not verified.
Currency of the HRDEM mosaic at downtown (which LiDAR vintage supplies it) and whether it includes towers built after 2022: not determined.
Geodetic control monuments or surveyed peak heights for Seymour, Grouse and the Lions as an alternative to Wikipedia heights: not searched in r2 because the web-search budget was used up.
change_log: Round 1: first version of packet C02; no earlier version exists.
Corrected scope assumptions: Google Open Buildings has no Canada coverage; only the 2009 City footprints have heights; EPSG:26910 is not NAD83(CSRS); City publishes no 2018/2022 DEM rasters.
Added M01 datum registry after finding City LiDAR is CGVD28GVRD, HRDEM and MRDEM are CGVD2013, SRTM is EGM96, GLO-30 is EGM2008.
Added hand-checkable validation cases, including computed UTM tile corners and Vista-frame offsets.

r1: BLOCKER fixed. Rewrote M05 around measured coverage: NRCan extent polygons, HRDEM mosaic WMS point queries and the LidarBC tile index show no open 1 m LiDAR at Grouse, Seymour or Lions samples; ridges are MRDEM-30 (GLO-30-derived). Metric 'Mountain DTM accuracy by source' set to false_assumption_corrected.

r1: Corrected the geoid to HTMVBC00 (City portal) with epoch 1997; added the three PROJ epoch variants (EPSG:10617/10618/10619), a same-source 2013 datum bridge, a vgridshift sign test, and a not-ballpark transform assertion. Noted MRDEM and LidarBC cite CGG2013.

r1: Documented Vista's frame error as a wrong latitude constant (0.58% short, 0.19% east-west); added Vista-to-UTM transform tests and Vista's SRTM re-seating of buildings (median +0.48 m, -12.2 to +21.6 m) to M07.
r1: Replaced parcel-polygon IoU in M02 with one-sided coverage ratios plus roof-height-break splitting; made LiDAR outlines the default for roofs 30 m and higher; QA now on DSM hillshade.

r1: M04 now publishes absolute cone elevation as the primary output, labels above-ground values 'not the bylaw base surface', adds sigma, an existing-tower regression and a view-origin eye-height parameter.
r1: Fixed tile rule (13 tiles within 1.5 km, 20 within 2 km), recorded 403 for default clients, measured sizes and set a browser-download plus checksum procedure.
r1: Added reduced 13 Nov core (about 14 person-days) against a full plan of about 39; M07 and M08 moved to v1 with core slices.
r1: M03 percentile operator clarified; new dataset LidarBC Provincial LiDAR 2025 for post-2022 tower detection; licences, Vista per-building cost with index files, peak check relaxed to 15 m.

r2: BLOCKER/MAJOR M01. Rebuilt the CGVD2013 to CGVD28GVRD chain on HTMVBC00 (GeoBC 37.5 KB BYN read with GDAL -unscale) plus CGG2013an83: H28 = H2013 + N_CGG2013a - N_HTMVBC00; national HT2 grids demoted to cross-check; added maps of HTMVBC00 minus HT2_1997 and CGG2013an83 minus CGG2013n83. Flag raised: 'unquantifiable' was false.

r2: Tightened the datum bridge from 0.15 m to 0.03 m and added a negative test (unconverted median at about +0.12 m within 0.03 m); metric set to false_assumption_corrected. EPSG 0.0 accuracy declared definitional; sigma_datum now from measured residuals. EPSG 10617 source verified as CGVD28(HTv2.0), not GVRD.

r2: M04/M01 cone-test frame fixed: compare geodetic H directly at the same (E,N), no curvature terms; curvature only for line-of-sight rendering. Added the level-cone unit test (2.04 m at 5.1 km, 1.78 m with refraction, recomputed), sigma_curv in the error budget, and an UNRESOLVED flag on the City convention.

r2: Deleted the Thurlow/Haro ground inference (13 m expected, HRDEM reads 40.75 m, re-measured); 361 ft kept only as an unverified figure. Added the Barclay 3.2.1 range (123.2 to 143.4 m) versus 'horizontal lower boundary' conflict as a flag and validation case.

r2: Reclassified the 3D BAG RMSE (0.31 m, 1.06 m) as a block-fit metric after reading Dukai et al. s.3.2 (wall points included; flat class median about 2.5 m). Tower-height metrics now use an error budget and are set to false_assumption_corrected (M03, M07).

r2: M03 now stores max_bldg and max_all (unfiltered, non-vegetation, non-water, plus n_above_bldg); cone tests and the regression use max_all; class codes must be read from a tile header; added a max_all gap-review metric and synthetic-mast test.

r2: Cut the 13 Nov core from about 14 to about 7 person-days (6.0 plus 1.0 contingency): M01 1.0, M02 0.5 (reproject plus 15 hand-traced towers, conflation to v1), M03 2.0, M04 1.0, M05 0.5, M06 0.5, M08 0.5; M07, LidarBC differencing and conflation moved to v1. Full packet unchanged at about 39.

r2: M07 Vista errors restated against true-north ENU (computed with ECEF: (0,3940) E 0.0 N +22.9; SE corner 31.1 m); UTM offsets kept separately for exchange, with grid convergence -0.0915 deg explaining the +6.3 m easting. Added flag.

r2: M05 coverage restated from a fresh LidarBC index query (2016: 32 tiles, 2019: 72, 2024: 24, none 2025); the earlier '2025 0%' breakdown missed the 2024 project. MRDEM-30 Table 2 now read from the PDF text (GLO-30-derived column is versus HRDEM DTM, not RTK); added the MRDEM-30-SOURCE asset (10, 5, 1) as the coverage tool; accuracy metric now verified.

r2: Added water-level parameter from CHS 07735 (MWL 3.06 m above chart datum; CGVD28 offset -3.00 gives +0.06 m, CGVD2013 offset -2.88 gives +0.18 m), supporting the +0.12 m sign; horizontal-offset test (City 2022 vs COPC 2016 roof corners, flag above 0.15 m); Microsoft heights row updated (431K heights 2026-07-24, unverified for Vancouver).

r2: M08 gained a provenance rule (every value cites dataset id plus checksum, or document plus page; no model-generated values, including GPT-6 Astra) and grid licences: NRCan OGL-Canada, NGA EGM Public Domain (PROJ-data READMEs read), HTMVBC00 unstated. Tile note added: 14 and 21 squares intersect, 13 and 20 listed (492000_5460000 absent, re-verified).

r2: Source ids: S11 reassigned to the GDAL BYN driver page (its registry facts merged into S09); S26, S28, S32, S10, S14, S19, S20, S23 extracts updated. Web-search budget ran out in r2, so only direct fetches and local PDF text extraction were used.
notes: Core for 13 Nov 2026 is about 7 person-days (6.0 plus 1.0 contingency); full packet about 39. City LiDAR 2022 is the downtown source; HTMVBC00 plus CGG2013a is the CGVD2013 to CGVD28GVRD chain. Cone tests compare geodetic H directly and every figure stays 'estimate' until views@vancouver.ca confirms datum and curvature. Ridges use MRDEM-30. r2 used direct fetches only (web-search limit reached); no data files were downloaded and the HTMVBC00 BYN still needs approval.
